summary: Military aircraft conducting high-energy manoeuvres supporting ground troops within 5 nautical miles of Hunderthwaite, surface to 5,000 feet.
text:
AIR EXER. 1 MIL ACFT WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN
SUPPORT OF GROUND TROOPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 543546N 0020335W
(HUNDERTHWAITE). ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KNOTS IAS 
AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC Y007/2023 
REFERS. OPS CTC ON CH 127.185 OR 277.350MHZ FOR INFO 07517 258611. 
AR-2026-10132/01.
